Common nucleophiles used in Sn2 reactions include hydroxide ions (OH-), alkoxide ions (RO-), and cyanide ions (CN-). The reaction typically occurs in polar aprotic solvents, which help to stabilize the transition state and enhance the nucleophilicity of the attacking species.
